name: Camí de l'Ossa
description_md:
The Camí de l'Ossa is a waymarked hiking route in AD that starts and finishes at the same place. This hard route covers 33.9 km with 1940 m of ascent and 1941 m of descent.

The route is part of the local waymarked hiking network and is signposted as CO. The walking time is about 15 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule. This hard rating is derived from the distance and ascent. The route passes Encamp within 100 m and Roc de les Bruixes within 1700 m.
